articles.title: NASA contract confirms selection of ULA’s Centaur 5 as new upper stage for the SLS rocket
articles.summary: The upper stage of United launch Alliance’s Vulcan rockets performed successfully across the first four flights of the rocket since 2024. The first launch of a Centaur 5 as part of a Space Launch System rocket would be on the Artemis 4 mission.
